description: This file implements an Azure Speech-to-Text service class for real-time audio transcription within the Pipecat project. It manages speech recognition sessions, processes audio streams, and handles transcription results asynchronously, integrating with Azure Cognitive Services SDK.

classes.name: AzureSTTService
classes.description: Implements Azure Cognitive Services Speech SDK for real-time speech recognition, managing audio streams, recognition sessions, and handling transcription callbacks.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the AzureSTTService with API key, region, language, sample rate, and optional endpoint ID, configuring the Azure Speech SDK.

methods.name: can_generate_metrics
methods.description: Indicates that this service supports metrics generation, returning True.

methods.name: run_stt
methods.description: Processes incoming audio bytes, feeds them into the Azure recognizer, and yields frames or errors asynchronously.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the speech recognition session, setting up the audio stream and recognizer, and begins continuous recognition.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the recognition session and closes audio streams and recognizer.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Immediately cancels recognition, stopping processes and closing resources.

methods.name: _handle_transcription
methods.description: Handles transcription results with tracing, stopping metrics collection.

methods.name: _on_handle_recognized
methods.description: Callback for recognized speech events, creates transcription frames, and schedules processing.

methods.name: _on_handle_recognizing
methods.description: Callback for recognizing speech events, creates interim transcription frames, and schedules pushing frames.
